input: Find chess, Minecraft, game design, coding and robotics camps for kids and teens in the Asheville area of Western North Carolina (within about an hour of Asheville). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: Asheville summer camp 2026 coding robotics Minecraft chess
Asheville coding robotics camps Bricks Snapology

candidates.name: Zaniac Asheville
candidates.note: 2026 camps for grades K–8 included Minecraft, coding, robotics and chess; locations in South Asheville and at UNC Asheville.

candidates.name: Asheville Math
candidates.note: 2026 Game Camp for grades 5–10 included chess, strategy games and designing campers’ own games.

candidates.name: Bricks 4 Kidz Asheville–Arden
candidates.note: LEGO-based summer camps for ages 5–13 include robotics, coding, video-game design and animation.

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: High-school pre-college engineering and mechatronics program includes building BOE-Bot robots and programming in C++.

candidates.name: Asheville Museum of Science
candidates.note: Summer of Science day camps ran in 2025 and 2026; programming includes computer-programming concepts alongside other sciences.

candidates.name: XP League Asheville
candidates.note: Summer camps include Minecraft Redstone engineering and supervised esports skills activities.

candidates.name: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics
candidates.note: 2026 Morganton Summer Accelerator offerings included Design, Build, Code and cybersecurity; programs serve rising grades 7–12.
